project_name: ATOMQUEST HACKATHON 1.0 - Goal Setting & Tracking Portal

theme_and_archetype.description: A serious, modern, and trustworthy HR/performance tool. Instead of generic playful aesthetics or 'fintech-bro' neon, we use a deep obsidian base with stark white and functional amber accents. The design focuses on extreme clarity, dense 'Control Room' grids, and unapologetic contrast.

fonts.name: Cabinet Grotesk
fonts.usage: Use for all H1, H2, and H3 headings. Ensure font-weight is 700 or 800 to give authoritative, sharp presence.

fonts.name: Satoshi
fonts.usage: Use for all UI copy, paragraphs, and standard labels.

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.usage: CRITICAL: Use for all numerical data, percentages, weightages (e.g. '10%'), targets, and check-in inputs. Makes data alignment perfect and feels extremely professional.

layout_and_spacing.global_geometry: Sharp corners. Override shadcn's default rounded-md to rounded-none or rounded-sm. Dashboards look more authoritative when squared off.

dashboard_grid.logic: Use rigid column grids. The main tracking panel should take up 3/4 width, sidebars or quick actions 1/4 width.

layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). For the dashboard, utilize border-collapse styles or right/bottom borders only to give an exposed skeleton feel. Avoid floating shadow cards.

component_rules.buttons: Square edges (rounded-sm). High contrast. Primary buttons are white with black text. No soft drop shadows; rely on stark contrast.
component_rules.inputs: Square edges. Background should match surface color, borders zinc-800. On focus, ring with amber-400 (not blue).
component_rules.tables: Dense. Use smaller paddings (py-2 px-3) to fit multiple goals. Use JetBrains Mono for weightage and target columns. Align numeric columns to the right.
component_rules.progress_bars: 1px to 2px tall. Extremely thin and sharp. Color maps to status (Amber for On Track, Emerald for Completed). No rounded ends.
component_rules.charts: Recharts. Use sharp linear lines, no curved splines. Use the status colors provided. Tooltips must have dark glassmorphism backgrounds.
component_rules.navigation: Side navigation is preferred for dense dashboards. If top nav, use Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-800).

login_hero_bg.description: Abstract dark architectural 3d geometry for the Login/Landing page split-screen background.

analytics_bg.description: Topographic map lines glowing for a subtle header background in the Analytics or Completion dashboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply data-testid to all interactive elements, form fields, tab triggers, and buttons (e.g. data-testid='goal-submit-button', data-testid='weightage-input').
In tailwind.config.js, ensure fonts are added as 'heading', 'body', and 'mono'.
Install lucide-react (if not present) and @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboards.

When rendering the multi-goal creation form, ensure validation logic for weightage summing to 100% is clearly visible to the user as they type, leveraging color_system.status.at_risk if it exceeds 100%.
Do not use generic Shadcn shadow classes; use strict border-zinc-800 for visual separation.
For the audit trail timeline, use a left-aligned vertical border (border-l-2 border-zinc-800) with absolute positioned indicator dots.
Do NOT use .tsx, ensure everything is in standard .js/.jsx syntax as per the project environment.
Use Phosphor icons for dense dashboard layouts if possible, otherwise stick to Lucide but maintain consistent sizing (16px/20px).
